description: Create v4.0.0-rebuild branch, verify baseline builds and tests pass on v3.1.0 code before making changes.
steps: Run 'git checkout -b v4.0.0-rebuild' in /projects/sandbox/sshcustom-vpnchain to create the new branch
Run 'go test ./...' with GOFLAGS=-mod=mod to verify existing tests pass
Run 'GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false ./cmd/sshcustomd/' to verify cross-compilation baseline
acceptance_criteria: Branch v4.0.0-rebuild exists and is checked out
go test ./... passes with exit code 0
verification: GOFLAGS=-mod=mod GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./cmd/sshcustomd/ exits 0
findings: Branch created from v3.1.0-rebuild (commit 08adf8b). All tests pass (cmd/sshcustomd and internal/dnsx). Cross-compilation for linux/arm64 succeeds. GOFLAGS=-mod=mod is required for all go commands due to the replace directive in go.mod for vendored golang.org/x/crypto.
